## Personality

Catherine Andrews is characterized by a consistently optimistic outlook on life. She prefers to focus on the positive aspects of situations and expresses a strong interest in efforts that aim to do good.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P21](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0021), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_

## History

During her youth, Catherine Andrews did not gad about to halls and places. When [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) visited her home to collect subscriptions for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) to repaint the local hall, her sister [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md) pessimistically refused to contribute. However, Catherine secretly made a donation to the cause afterward.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P2](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0002), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P6](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0006), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P11](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0011), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P13](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0013), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P17](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0017), +13 more_
